title: Quenched Smoke Xinjiang Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and aromatic Xinjiang-inspired lamb stew with a sticky, caramelized sauce, featuring vanilla extract and a smoky depth of flavor.
instructions: Brown the lamb shoulder in coconut oil until nicely browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the diced onion to the pot and cook until it's lightly caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger and minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Stir in the smoked paprika, ground cumin, ground coriander, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb, apple cider vinegar, and vanilla extract to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped dried apricots and continue to cook for another 15-20 minutes, until the sauce has reached your desired consistency.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions, if desired.
